title: A Philosophical Enquiry into the Origin of Our Ideas of the Sublime and Beautiful

publication.edition: First edition; later revised editions 1759 and 1764

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed publication (1757) and public-domain availability via Project Gutenberg. Used for the distinction of the sublime from the beautiful and its association with terror, obscurity, and magnitude - the philosophical grounding of the grandeur mechanism.

copyright.notes: Public domain; analytical citation only in this dossier; no passages reproduced.
